definitions: A small pocket just below the waistband of a pair of trousers or in a waistcoat, used for carrying a watch or other small items.
A chain or ribbon attached to a watch and hanging out of a fob pocket.
A small ornament or seal attached to a watch chain.
A small, flat, often plastic device used to control a remote locking system, especially for a car or to gain access to a building.
examples: He kept his grandfather's watch in his fob.
The watch had a decorative fob.
She dangled the car fob in her hand.
He used his security fob to enter the building.
